{{Top|leg}}
'''Log-recorders''' were used in [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to record the vessel's vital data, such as the system status and flight path. They were primarily used in reconstructing accidents on a ship, to determine the cause of the problem and also to resolve any issues that the problem may have caused.
